components.name: Apex Nexus check-in
components.description: EHR patient check-in. Requests records or the PHQ-2 from the patient's health app (the phone's wallet or any registered web wallet), verifies SMART Health Cards, and sends results to the chart's review queue. The desk can show a code so the patient checks in on their own phone.
components.notes: Accept the one-time confidentiality notice. Choose Pre-visit records (scenarios 1 and 3; decline Immunizations for 3) or Depression screen (PHQ-2) (scenario 2). 'On their phone' shows a code to scan with the phone that holds the wallet (native path); 'On this device' lists the registry's web wallets. The Connectathon testing panel on the page has the scenario notes and the result-report link. Synthetic data only.
